transcriber_notes: Boundaries printed on right axis (10.64 px/cm); 26, 5 and 4 labels offset by slanted leaders, bar edges agree. Hardness from bar ends in pixels (grid I/K/P/1F/4F/F at 367/483/599/715/831/947 px; thirds as +/-): 793 px -> 4F+. Red highlight lines in this chart sit just ABOVE the 76, 64 and 27 cm boundary lines (unlike other Avanet charts where they sit just below); attributed to the layer above by position and bar width (the 76 cm line spans the F width shared by both adjacent layers). Temperatures are vertices of a continuous red polyline without markers (vertex heights located from slope changes: 86, 76, 66, 56, 46, 33, 30, 20, 0 cm), 0 C at x~994 px and 20.8 px/C, which reproduces the printed air temp -11.0 at the dashed top; +-0.2 C / +-1 cm.
